briefs.brief: The docs home for Ferrule, a command-line tool that keeps dotfiles in sync across a developer's machines. Areas: install, guides, CLI reference, config file, troubleshooting.
Ferrule's 'Get started' article: install it, run the first sync, and check it worked. Include two short code blocks.
The homepage for Quillmate, a meeting-notes app for small design agencies. It records, writes the summary and files action items to the right project.
The product page for the Halden lamp, a dimmable aluminium desk lamp in three finishes, with a warm-to-cool light dial.
The account settings screen for Ledgerline, an invoicing web app for freelancers: profile, business details, payment methods, notifications, plan.
